svg.aria-label: Real CSD torsion pattern with V1 to V6 Fourier components and their sum, plus the Chebyshev recurrences that compute cos kφ from a single cosine.
svg.text: M6 torsion: V(φ) = Σₖ Vₖ (1 + sₖ cos kφ) — one real CSD pattern
[C:1][CX4H2:2]!@;-[NX3:3][C:4] e.g. the C–C–N–C torsion of triethylamine
minima at ±75° (6.9) and ±162° (7.3); syn 0° peaks at 23.4 — anti is split by a 0.3 bump
c = cos φ (from the dot product)
no atan2, no extra trig calls
